experiment: Causal annual transfer audit: frozen MSE20 decoded features versus a fixed simple OHLCV representation

Per-fold training and forecasting are causal, but architecture and this research design were selected retrospectively. No independent holdout, full paper replication, historical availability reconstruction, profitability or promotion claim.

simple_features.name: raw25_probe
simple_features.formula: At anchor t and each h: log(C_t)-log(C_(t-h)); population SD of log(C_s)-log(C_(s-1)) for s=t-h+1..t; mean(log(C_s)-log(O_s)) over those h sessions; mean(log(H_s)-log(L_s)) over those h sessions; log(1+V_t)-log(1+V_(t-h)). Concatenate in horizon-major order.25fixed coordinates. The longest change uses121price bars, within the common125bar history allowance. No fitted feature parameters, clipping, indicator selection or future inputs.
simple_features.comparison_limit: Matching25coordinates and the same readout objective does not match total model capacity. The learned representation has supervised neural training; the raw representation does not. This is a practical fixed-feature comparison, not an isolated causal test of architecture.

standardization.description: Each head uses its own training-column means and population SDs only. Apply frozen statistics to future rows. No normalization across folds, seed averaging before feature fitting, or rotations.

probe.objective: Mean unweighted binary log loss plus lambda/2 times sum of squared slopes in standardized coordinates. Intercept is not penalized. No auxiliary or return loss. Initialize slopes0 and intercept logit(training_up_frequency). Same single regularization value and full-batch float64 Newton solver for both families. No lambda, window, feature, seed or threshold search.
